system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 35. 4 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (24 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (ominous, deliberate): "Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead."
[b01] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (breathless): "Who?"
[b02] ACTION: Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.
[b03] ALEXANDER (brooding): "I spent three years trying to find out."
[b04] ACTION: Alexander abruptly pushes away from the window, storming back toward the table with burning rage.
[b05] ALEXANDER (fierce, resolute): "The ambush was not an accident."
[b06] ALEXANDER (vehement, enraged): "Someone ordered my men to die."
[b07] ACTION: He leans heavily over the wooden table, looming close as his fury boils over.
[b08] ALEXANDER (darkly intimating): "Someone wanted me erased."
[b09] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (gasping, terrified): "Who?"
[b10] ALEXANDER (deadly, chilling): "The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now."

--- WINDOW 1 (37 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (sobbing, stunned): "Alexander!"
[b01] ALEXANDER (breathless, in disbelief): "Mother?"
[b02] ACTION: She drops her walking staff and rushes forward, throwing her arms around Alexander's neck. He pulls her tightly into his chest.
[b03] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (weeping, overwhelmed): "You're alive."
[b04] ALEXANDER (gentle, choked up): "Mother."
[b05] ACTION: She leans back slightly, her frail hand reaching up to gently cup his bearded, scarred cheek, staring into his eyes in disbelief.
[b06] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (tearful, heartbroken): "I buried you."
[b07] ALEXANDER (soft, somber): "I know."
[b08] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (anguished, accusing): "They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed."
[b09] ALEXANDER (dark, resigned): "Most of them were."
[b10] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (searching, desperate): "Then how did you survive?"

--- WINDOW 2 (20 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (searching, desperate): "Then how did you survive?"
[b01] ALEXANDER (grim, quiet): "I wasn't supposed to."
[b02] ACTION: Alexander steps over to the wooden table, looking down at the parchment map spread out under the lantern.
[b03] ALEXANDER (solemn): "Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front."
[b04] ALEXANDER (steady, focused): "It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies."
[b05] ACTION: Alexander's scarred finger points to a red-circled location on the parchment map marked near Madrid.
[b06] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (shocked): "A traitor?"

--- WINDOW 3 (21 seconds, code score 0.79) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (trembling, anxious): "And you?"
[b01] ALEXANDER (hollow): "I was shot. Left for dead."
[b02] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (pleading, astonished): "How did you escape?"
[b03] ALEXANDER (somber, low): "I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone."
[b04] ALEXANDER: "I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead."
[b05] ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (aghast, stunned): "Then why did they never tell us?"

Pick the single best promo.
